decision.what: Two small local fixes for the ai2 hang, found from a CDP CPU profile
decision.chose: (1) groups.js: memoize Groups.members(gid) keyed by a _rev counter bumped in changed() — before, one paint() call recomputed it 6-8x per group (inside ordered()'s sort, latest(), the size count, cost(), and the at_of loop), and the profile's top groups.js entries (at(), its index array, card_words()) all trace back to that. (2) live.js: place()'s call to wide() forces a synchronous getComputedStyle layout read; it ran on every redraw of the Live card (the page's own default view), which was the single biggest self-time entry in the whole profile (748.9ms). Now only the card's own ResizeObserver (a real resize) remeasures; an ordinary redraw reuses the cached answer.
decision.alternative: Rewriting card_page()'s draw() to dedupe the Live item's signature before a full DOM rebuild — bigger, touches more of page.js, left as a later idea in profile.md instead.

assign.now: Took before/after CPU profiles and timer-lag probes, before/after shots at 400 and 1920, wrote profile.md, and documented the fix in ai2/readme.md and ai2/doc/decisions.md. Ready to land.

decision.what: INBOX ZERO batch (followup.md §4): archived_pending robustness fix, Clear all, the ≥min score display rule, and two one-line edits from minion-priority (score_for(...) ?? x.score, items({...groups}))
decision.chose: archive()/clear_all() add ids to a session-lived archived_pending Set instead of splicing list once; paint() re-applies it every rebuild via apply_pending_archives(), so a row asked to leave never silently reappears when list gets rebuilt from items() before the server write lands. Found via headless proof (test-clearall.mjs) that a CORS gap on Servex's own :8090 blocks the folder-card write route (/card/append) from this worktree's origin (localhost:51490) — the read route (/card?id=) and the board-card write route (the dev socket's RPC) both work fine from here. Documented in profile.md §4; flagging to the parent rather than guessing at a Servex change, since Servex is outside this task's fence.
decision.alternative: A plain one-shot list.splice() per archive action — tried first, proven insufficient headless: the very next paint() from any other stream silently undid it before the (possibly slow, here CORS-blocked) write ever landed.
